'''Grillhog''' is a [[Fire]] type [[Healer]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Souphog]] at 6 bronze stars, and evolves into [[Hothog]] at 18 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "What's wrong with carrying all your favorite snacks around? You'll hardly get hungry, and they're extra handy when Zobos come around. Perfect, don't you think?"

Grillhog is a gold rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A small pig wedged between the buns, cheese, and meat of a cheeseburger. It has a tear in its eye.

Grillhog's [[Tatari#Glitter Tataris|Glitter]] variant changes the yellow cheese and sesame seeds of the burger to be cyan instead.

== Evolution Trial ==
Grillhog's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 18 stars. To evolve it into [[Hothog]] you need to complete the following two tasks:
* Feed Grillhog to increase stats 3 times.
* Play Snowboard Sprint/Marathon Party (use x2000 boards) or Cozy Farm (use x4000 fertilizer).

== Trivia ==
* Original Bio: "When your Grillhog gets hurt, don't be surprised when it yells, 'You don't win friends with salad!'"
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "When your Grillhog gets hurt, don't be shocked to learn that you don't win friends with salad."
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Accidentally got caught between some meat patties and cheese, and now Grillhog cries from the crushing weight of a hamburger."
